draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.55, the 254th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 18th of 18 at TE. He went 192nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (254th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 282 receiving yards in 2021, 13th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Indianapolis Colts. 44 career games and 20 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2023. Weak spots: receiving yards 27 (8th percentile), approximate value 0 (9th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 27 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
